name: r20_bollinger_strength_v1

pool.note: the research pool of the evidence, not the 10-name pool A

factor.name: bollinger_pctb
factor.std: population (ddof=0) of the last 20 split-adjusted closes, signal day included
factor.select: within-day percentile rank inside the pool > 2/3 (top tercile, about 33 names)

treatment: top tercile by %b inside the R20 top 100, equal weight, U15D10 list basis (next-day open, +15% / -10% / 20 sessions, cost 0.3%)
control: the full R20 top 100 on the same days (control A)
primary_metric: success rate (+15% before -10%) treatment minus control, same-day paired, Newey-West(19) t
pass_if: primary (treatment minus control A) > 0 and t >= 1.96
per-trade U15D10 treatment minus control A > 0
treatment stop-first share not above control A
treatment minus random third: success difference > 0 (t reported; not part of the pass line, decides whether the factor adds beyond subset selection)

deep_validation_20261016.pool_level: real in R20 (placebo 0/300, leave-one-month-out t>=3.6 OOS) but same-industry IS +1.3 (t0.6) and model ranks 1-50 IS +2.3 (t0.6)
deep_validation_20261016.list_level: r20 top20 +6.4 IS / +6.2 OOS success vs random third +6.0 / +3.2: factor adds ~0.4 / ~3.0
deep_validation_20261016.S20: fails, not part of this rule

control_random.name: random third
control_random.definition: on each signal day a random third (round(n/3) names) of the R20 top 100, drawn with a fixed per-day seed derived from the signal date (seed = int(signal_date)), so the draw can be reproduced; one draw per day
control_random.purpose: R20 top 20 is worse than the top-100 mean, so any subset looks better; the factor must beat a random subset of the same size, not only the whole pool

secondary_metrics: pool level: treatment minus random third, success rate, same-day paired, NW(19) t (reported, must be > 0)

list level: r20_pred top 20 taken inside the top tercile by %b, minus the plain r20_pred top 20, and minus the same list taken inside the random third; success rate and per-trade, same-day paired, NW(19) t
